concept.hr: pet vrijednosti razdvaja mnogo veza na jednom portu 443
concept.en: the 5-tuple keeps many connections apart on one port 443

summary.hr: Otvori veze s nekoliko klijenata prema istom poslužitelju: kad segment stigne, OS ga traži u tablici po protokolu, adresama i portovima.
summary.en: Open connections from several clients to one server: when a segment arrives, the OS finds its row by protocol, addresses and ports.

concept.hr: isti poslužiteljski socket, različit izvorni port: dvije veze
concept.en: the same server socket, a different source port: two connections

title.hr: Isti par socketa je ista veza
title.en: The same pair of sockets is one connection

concept.hr: SYN s portom koji već ima veza pada na postojeći redak, ne na novi
concept.en: a SYN from a port already in a connection hits the existing row, not a new one
